analysis.rationale: R0 rejected the analyzer's MOTION_BLUR verdict (5/5 pairs in R1 re-analysis) by comparing a single random-angle motion:4 draw (22.05) against gaussian:4 (25.83). R1 re-sampling shows that comparison was invalid: motion PSNR is angle-random (22.05-32.37 on pair0, 19.01-31.32 on pair2), and motion:3+jpeg:2 reaches >30 dB on two different images while the entire gaussian family (sev1-5) and lens:4 never exceed 25.9 dB on any pair. Supporting signals: PCA blur-kernel ratio 2.34-3.38 (4/5 >2.5, 0% FP / 41% recall) and residual_anisotropy 1.53-2.14 straddling the 1.7 motion threshold (the analyzer itself marks FFT anisotropy content-dominated, FP>80%, so values just below 1.7 do not argue against motion); gm_ratio 0.32-0.66 (very strong apparent blur) combined with spectral_slope_ratio only 1.15-1.31 is irreconcilable with isotropic gaussian/lens but expected for directional motion blur. glass_score is above the glass-only calibration band in all 5 pairs (expected inflation from JPEG 8x8 block artifacts), so it is not exclusion evidence; glass was directly re-tested at the correct jpeg:2 (22.89 dB, CI 9/10, spectral_slope diff 0.124) and remains a weaker secondary candidate. JPEG confirmed by block_boundary 1.59-2.43 (>1.1, 0% FP) in 5/5 pairs; jpeg:2 verified by signal block_boundary match (0% diff) and CI peak. NO_GLOBAL and NO_NOISE confirmed across all 5 pairs (variance_ratio 0.78-0.96 content-dependent, mean_shift -0.2..-0.5/255, chroma 0.91-1.03, clipped<=0.045; sigma 0.74-1.85<2, peeled residual structured spatial_corr 0.9945/0.9960, residual_intensity_corr sign flips across pairs -> gamma suspect rejected). Overall verdict stays UNCERTAIN because motion angle is random (PSNR not exactly reproducible) and pair4 shows a single-draw deficit.
analysis.caveats: pair4 single draw -2.14 dB and pair1 -1.00 dB vs control; angle randomness means the 5-pair PSNR cannot be reproduced per-pair for any motion candidate. CI (angle-robust) improved or matched on all 5 pairs. If downstream retraining must be conservative, blur_gaussian:4+jpeg:2 (R0) is the fallback alternative.
